notes: Eval layer on base profiles. ortg_full is a Dean Oliver / Basketball-Reference style ORtg in points form (see player_eval.py _oliver_ortg), box-score only; no play-by-play, no opponent adjustment on ortg_full itself. ortg_simple is the base simplified ORtg. ratings.rpr is RPR v1.2 (headline since 28 Nov 2026): ORtg shrunk toward the league average (K = 200 possessions used) and opponent-adjusted (OppAdj K = 150 in November), with the counting terms centered on the league-average per-36 rates, defense full-weighted, no minutes shrink and no minutes floor, so an average player scores about 0; the parallel v1.3 values are kept as rpr_v13, with the old values rpr_v1 and rpr_v1_1, value delivered as rpr_value = RPR v1.2 * GP / 82). The RPR component breakdown sums to RPR v1.2. Trending window is the last 7 days of games in the data.
